## Terms of Service

Last updated: 25 October 2026

## Who we are and what these terms cover

These terms are an agreement between you and CodeLitDev Private Limited, a company registered in India ("CodeLit", "we", "us"), for your use of the hosted SendLit service at [app.sendlit.app](http://app.sendlit.app), including the dashboard, the REST API, the MCP server and the embeddable email blocks when they talk to our hosted service (together, "SendLit" or "the Service").

By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these terms. If you use SendLit for a company or other organization, you agree on its behalf and confirm you have authority to do so.

SendLit is open source. If you host SendLit yourself, these terms don't apply to your installation. The server, dashboard and docs are licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 or later, and the embeddable packages (@sendlit/email-editor, @sendlit/email-blocks and @sendlit/api-contract) are licensed under the MIT License. See [github.com/codelitdev/sendlit](http://github.com/codelitdev/sendlit).

## What SendLit does

SendLit is an email marketing layer. It lets you manage contacts, design templates, send broadcasts, run automated sequences and send transactional email.

SendLit does not deliver email itself. You connect your own email service provider (for example Amazon SES, Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark, Resend or any SMTP server), and SendLit sends your messages through that provider using the credentials you give us. Your provider's own terms and charges apply to that delivery, and you pay your provider directly.

## Your account

- You sign in with a one-time code sent to your email address. Keep access to that email account, your API keys and any connected apps secure.

- You're responsible for everything done with your account, organizations and teams, including by team members you invite and by apps and AI agents you connect over the API or MCP. They act with the permissions you grant.

- Tell us right away at [hi@codelit.dev](mailto:hi@codelit.dev) if you think someone else is using your account.

- Accounts are logins. Plans, billing and limits belong to organizations, and contacts, templates and sending settings belong to teams inside an organization.

## Your responsibilities as the sender

You are the sender of every email you send with SendLit, and you are the controller of your contact lists. That means:

- You must have a lawful basis, and where required clear consent, to email every contact you upload or import.

- You must follow the email and privacy laws that apply to you and your recipients, including the US CAN-SPAM Act, the EU and UK GDPR and ePrivacy rules, and Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL).

- You must honor unsubscribe requests, include accurate sender information and a valid physical mailing address in marketing email, and not use misleading subject lines or headers.

- You must keep your email provider account, sending domains and DNS records in good standing.

- You must follow our Acceptable Use Policy at [sendlit.app/acceptable-use](http://sendlit.app/acceptable-use), which is part of these terms.

## Acceptable use

You may not use SendLit to send spam, phishing, malware or illegal content, or to email lists that were bought, rented or scraped. The full rules, the deliverability thresholds we monitor and how we enforce them are in our Acceptable Use Policy at [sendlit.app/acceptable-use](http://sendlit.app/acceptable-use).

You also may not try to break into, overload or get around the limits of the Service, or resell access to the hosted Service as a standalone product without our written agreement.

## Plans and billing

- SendLit offers a Free plan and paid plans. Current plans, limits and prices are shown at [sendlit.app/#pricing](/pricing) and at checkout.

- Plans are based on organizations and the email you send, not on seats. Paid plans don't add a per-email charge, but sending is subject to fair-use and deliverability limits. Your email provider bills you separately for delivery.

- Paid plans are billed in advance, monthly or yearly, through our payment provider, Dodo Payments, and renew automatically until cancelled. Dodo Payments acts as our merchant of record and handles payment, your card details, taxes and invoices; we don't see your full card number.

- Some plans may include a free trial. If you don't cancel before the trial ends, the paid plan starts.

- We may change prices. We'll tell you at least 30 days before a price change applies to your plan.

## Cancellation and refunds

- Organization owners can cancel a paid plan at any time from the organization's Plan tab. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid period, and you won't be charged again.

- When a paid plan ends, the organization moves to the Free plan. Your data isn't deleted, but Free plan limits apply.

- Refunds: payments already made are not refunded unless the law requires it.

## Suspension

We may warn you, limit sending, pause campaigns or suspend your account or a team, with or without notice, if we reasonably believe you:

- have bounce or complaint rates that put deliverability or other customers at risk (see the thresholds in our Acceptable Use Policy);

- are sending spam, phishing, malware or other prohibited content, or emailing people without permission;

- have broken these terms or the law, or haven't paid; or

- are using the Service in a way that threatens its security or stability.

Where it's reasonable, we'll tell you why and give you a chance to fix the problem. Transactional sending may continue at a reduced limit while marketing sending is paused.

## Your data

- Your content stays yours. That includes your contacts, templates, campaigns and media.

- You give us permission to store, copy, process and transmit your content only as needed to provide and secure the Service for you, for example to render and send your emails, track opens and clicks, and process unsubscribes.

- We process personal data in your contact lists on your behalf, as your processor, under our Data Processing Agreement at [sendlit.app/dpa](http://sendlit.app/dpa). Our Privacy Policy at [sendlit.app/privacy](http://sendlit.app/privacy) explains how we handle account and billing data.

- You can export your contacts and data while your account is open. Keep your own backups of anything important.

## Our intellectual property

Apart from your content and the rights you have under the open-source licenses, we and our licensors own the hosted Service, the SendLit name and logo, and our website. These terms don't give you any right to use our trademarks.

## Warranty disclaimer

We work hard to keep SendLit running and secure, but the Service is provided "as is" and "as available". To the extent the law allows, we make no warranties, express or implied, including about merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, non-infringement, availability or that the Service will be error-free. We don't control your email provider or recipients' mailbox providers, so we can't guarantee that any email will be delivered or reach the inbox.

## Limitation of liability

To the extent the law allows:

- CodeLit isn't liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential losses, or for lost profits, revenue, data or goodwill.

- Our total liability for all claims about the Service is limited to the amount you paid us for the Service in the 12 months before the claim.

- You're responsible for, and will cover us against, claims that result from your email content, your contact lists, or your use of the Service in breach of these terms or the law.

Nothing in these terms limits liability that can't be limited by law.

## Ending your account

- You can stop using SendLit at any time. To close your account or an organization and delete its data, use the dashboard where available or email us at [hi@codelit.dev](mailto:hi@codelit.dev). We'll delete the data within 30 days of your request.

- We may end these terms or close your account if you seriously or repeatedly break them, or if we stop offering the hosted Service. If we shut down the hosted Service, we'll give you at least 30 days' notice to export your data.

- Sections that by their nature should survive (such as data ownership, disclaimers, limitation of liability and governing law) survive termination.

## Changes to these terms

When we change these terms, we'll update the date at the top. For significant changes, we'll notify account owners by email before they take effect. If you keep using SendLit after that, you accept the new terms.

## Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India, and disputes will be handled by the courts of Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.
